features.description: Wire architecture_levels.write_levels into the build so the diff-able per-level .mmd slices regenerate from the current architecture snapshot into the DontPanic repo's docs/architecture/levels/; guard so foreign/fleet builds never write levels into another project's tracked tree (cache-only).
features.acceptance: A build regenerates docs/architecture/levels/*.mmd from architecture.json (deterministic, diff-able); a test asserts the slices are emitted from a snapshot + that the foreign-repo guard prevents writing into a non-DontPanic tree.

features.description: Add a breadcrumb L2->L3 cluster-zoom to the EXISTING interactive Architecture SVG: a breadcrumb (All / <cluster>) filters the rendered nodes+edges to one cluster (by directory, mirroring cluster_key) and back; no mermaid runtime added.
features.acceptance: Clicking a cluster zooms the SVG to that cluster's nodes (+ the breadcrumb updates); clicking the breadcrumb root restores the full map; pure cluster-derivation logic is unit-tested + the page wiring is covered.
